source_title: Bournemouth 3-0 Aston Villa - the fans' verdict - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your thoughts after Wednesday's Carabao Cup ties between Bournemouth and Aston Villa .
Hugh: Showed rotation works with a strong squad. Great performance. Making it hard for the manager to pick a first team is good.
Tom: It is genuinely getting like Groundhog Day for the Cherries - go out midweek, win by two or more to nil, do the same at the weekend and repeat. We are in dream world. Hope to keep it up. Up the Cherries!
Malcolm: I have learned that whoever starts they have the trust of the manager and team-mates alike. The players know how Rose's system works and they execute the plan very well. Incoming players Soler, Juanlu and Diakite were all excellent and Rodriguez put in a shift up top. 3-0 is becoming a nice habit.
Graham: This squad of players fear no-one. Marco Rose has them playing well and this was another great result.
Joe: Poor game from Villa and Bournemouth wanted it more than us. Would've been nice to get through to the quarter-finals but I think we need to focus on the league and the Champions League. However, I still don't think that is an excuse to play like that. I was glad to see Alysson coming on and making an impact once again. I hope this continues and that we can forget about this loss and focus forward.
Pammy: Absolutely pathetic performance and all the Villa faithful in attendance should get their hard-earned money back. Mr Emery, you might be untouchable but you got this is so wrong.
Prit: If on Saturday we saw the Dr Jekyll Aston Villa, this was very much Mr Hyde. Bournemouth had more desire, closed down our defenders, broke quickly and totally deserved the victory.
Rob: A lacklustre display from a depleted Villa team but it's hard to be annoyed when we play Barcelona at the Nou Camp next week. The League Cup is always the last priority for Unai and I'm surprised that he risked the likes of McGinn with any game time at all. The fact is we don't have a deep enough squad to compete on four fronts so we put a line through this one and move on.
